narrative.details: The Battle in Alterac Valley rages on, adventurer! Have you done your part as of late, adventurer?
narrative.objectives: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
narrative.offerRewardText: You continue to honor the Alliance, adventurer. The Horde will be crushed before long if we keep our efforts up.
